verdict.rationale: Capacities ships first-party 'Chat Connectors' to link external LLM apps (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Le Chat) directly to a Capacities space, plus a documented MCP integration and REST API for building custom AI agents, and native AI assistant features (auto-fill, image analysis, chats) that are opt-in for privacy. This directly matches the story's requirement for first-party connectors and an AI/plugin ecosystem. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that these connectors work reliably in practice, and evidence of a broader third-party plugin marketplace beyond the vendor-listed connectors.
